cues.text: I'm not permitted to advise you. What follows isn't disclosure, isn't on the file, and if asked I'll say it didn't happen.
Ten thousand, two hundred and forty people came up those stairs to get to B. Every one of them. Not one came for A.
Nobody knew about A. You only hear the options if you pass.
A has always been available, long before me. It is the smart choice.
I've watched ten thousand people die about forty feet from ever knowing it existed.
Hmm, there is a third option...
It isn't on the form, but I know I read it somewhere.
You may have both elections, full soul and full knowledge.
But there is a cost, there is always a cost.
You must take the office, and the office doesn't let go until the backlog is closed. Ten thousand, two hundred and forty files.
I never had the courage to closed one.
Now. I'm going to do something I haven't done in eleven thousand years, and I'd like you to note the irregularity.
That's advice. That's actual advice. I'm not permitted to give it and I've given it, I'd appreciate it if you took it.
